lines.text: You already think like a programmer. Text languages like Python use the same ideas — just typed instead of dragged.
set → =, repeat (n) → for i in range(n), if-else → if/else, forever → while True, My Block → def, list → [ ].
In Python, the lines inside a loop or if are indented.
Indentation does the job of the C-shaped block in Scratch.
Python lists and strings start at index 0, not 1. letter (1) of word is word[0] in Python.
Blocks can’t be typed wrong, but text can: a missing colon or bracket stops the program.
Read error messages — they tell you the line.
FizzBuzz is a classic programming test. Read it carefully — you’re about to build it in blocks.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
